data.description:
## Problem

Agents working with the worklog system need a way to track and recover their session logs. Currently, there is no standardized process for linking worklog comments to Pi session logs.

## Proposed Solution

Add a new instruction to `AGENTS.md` requiring agents to add a comment to the worklog item being worked on whenever:
1. A new session is started
2. A new work item is created

## Required Comment Format

The comment should be in the form:

`<agent_action> - Session ID: <pi_session_id> - <path_to_sessions_log>`

Where:
- `<agent_action>` is a short description of the action being taken (e.g., `/intake`, `/plan`, `/implement`)
- `<pi_session_id>` is the current Pi session ID (available via the `PI_SESSION_ID` environment variable)
- `<path_to_sessions_log>` is the path to the Pi sessions log file

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `AGENTS.md` contains a clear instruction about adding session comments
- [ ] The instruction covers both session start and new work item creation scenarios
- [ ] The comment format is clearly documented with examples
- [ ] The instruction specifies where to find `pi_session_id` and `sessions_log` path (e.g., environment variables)
- [ ] The instruction is placed in a logical location within `AGENTS.md` (likely in the workflow or critical rules sections)
